verdict.rationale: Operating a GPU cloud through natural-language commands is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Lambda's own documentation shows only a console, a REST API, SSH/JupyterLab, and standard Slurm/Kubernetes tooling, with no first-party natural-language interface. The only natural-language path is an unofficial, community-built CLI/MCP server, which is a third-party workaround and earns no credit.
